# Denterra

> Denterra is a remote dental admin staffing company. It recruits, skill-verifies, and manages full-time international team members who handle insurance verification, claims and collections, treatment coordination, patient coordination, and credentialing for U.S. dental practices. Flat rate: $15/hour all-in. Co-founded by a practicing dentist inside Open Door Family Dentistry. A spin-off of Hybryd (hirehybryd.com).

## Key facts
- Price: $15 per hour, all-in, full-time only (40 hrs/week). About $31,200 per year per seat. No placement fees, no setup fees, no long-term contract.
- Time to start: team member seated and trained in 2 to 3 weeks; urgent seats in 7 to 10 days.
- Team members: experienced dental/medical admins from the Philippines, with recruiting in South America and Africa (Zimbabwe, Argentina). Recruiting partner: BYU Pathway Worldwide.
- Verified skills: HIPAA, dental terminology, top procedure codes, Dentrix / Eaglesoft / Open Dental, major carrier portals, Medicare/Medicaid billing basics.
- Compliance: HIPAA training before placement, secure workstation tooling, BAA signed with every practice.
- Roles: Insurance Verification, Claims & Collections, Treatment Coordinator Support, Patient Coordinator, Credentialing, Admin Team Lead.
- Re-match at no cost if the fit isn't right.
- Contact: recruitment@hiredenterra.com

## Blog
- [How Much Does a Remote Dental Insurance Verification Specialist Cost?](https://www.hiredenterra.com/blog/how-much-does-a-remote-dental-insurance-verification-specialist-cost.html): A plain breakdown of what a remote dental insurance verification specialist costs per hour and per year, compared with a U.S. in-office hire and a generic virtual assistant.
- [What Does a Dental Insurance Verification Specialist Do?](https://www.hiredenterra.com/blog/what-does-a-dental-insurance-verification-specialist-do.html): The day-to-day work of a dental insurance verification specialist: eligibility checks, benefit breakdowns, pre-authorizations, and why it decides how much your practice collects.
- [Remote Dental Admin vs In-Office Hire vs Generic Virtual Assistant](https://www.hiredenterra.com/blog/remote-dental-admin-vs-in-office-hire-vs-virtual-assistant.html): An honest comparison of the three ways dental practices fill admin seats: hiring locally, using a generic virtual assistant, or seating a dedicated remote dental admin team member.
- [How to Onboard a Remote Dental Admin Team Member (Week-by-Week)](https://www.hiredenterra.com/blog/how-to-onboard-a-remote-dental-admin-team-member.html): A practical onboarding checklist for dental practices adding a remote admin team member: access, phones, HIPAA and BAA, training plan, and the KPIs to watch in the first 90 days.
